headline: Tata Steel to Acquire 26.6% Stake in APL Apollo for ₹15,510 Crore
summary: Tata Steel announced plans to acquire a 26.6% stake in APL Apollo for ₹15,510 crore and launch an open offer. The deal includes Tata Steel selling its tubes business for up to ₹11,700 crore.
why: Tata Steel is one of India's largest steelmakers, and this transaction expands its downstream processing footprint.

impacts.name: Tata Steel
impacts.why: Tata Steel shares fell 7% following details of the large transaction and business reorganization.
